en.title: Minimum Total Chocolate Weight After Halving
en.description:
Each day, choose one piece and eat floor(w/2) of it, leaving ceil(w/2); the same piece may be chosen repeatedly. Find the minimum total weight after d days.

The input/output protocol was compiled independently by this site; upstream solutions are not executed.
en.input: The first line contains n d, and the second line contains n weights; n≤100000, 1≤w≤10000, 1≤d≤2000000.
en.output: Output the single integer required by the problem.
en.explanation: The answers to the three public examples are, in order: 31; 1; 4. All examples have been verified by independent small-scale enumeration or state search.
hints: Bucket the pieces by weight and halve one piece from the highest non-empty bucket; stop as soon as every weight is 1.
